anchor_release.modification_policy: READ_ONLY. curriculum-content/manuel-academy/1.0.0/** must not be modified by any session in this wave.

continuity_rule: Every subject family must publish exactly one course in every grade of the span. No grade may be skipped.

classification_vocabulary.STATE_REQUIREMENT: A Michigan Merit Curriculum graduation credit requirement. Recorded in credit-coverage-map.md with an official citation.
classification_vocabulary.STATE_STANDARD: A content expectation published in a Michigan Academic Standards document. Cited verbatim; never invented.
classification_vocabulary.MANUEL_ACADEMY_COURSE_DESIGN_DECISION: A local curricular choice about course naming, sequence, pacing, or emphasis that Michigan does not mandate.
classification_vocabulary.EXISTING_RELEASE_CONTENT: Already published in curriculum-content/manuel-academy/1.0.0 and frozen for this wave.

count_policy: Unit and lesson counts are deliberately unbound here. The assembly validator derives them from what the subject sessions actually return and checks internal consistency; it must not assert a pre-agreed lesson total.

courses.subject: mathematics

courses.scope_summary: Function analysis, trigonometry, vectors and matrices, limits readiness, and a statistics strand covering sampling, inference, and study design.

courses.subject: english-language-arts

courses.subject: english-language-arts
courses.course_name: English 11: American Literature, Research, and Synthesis
courses.title: English 11: American Literature, Research, and Synthesis

courses.title: English 12: Global Literature, Composition, and Portfolio Capstone

courses.subject: science

declared_coverage_gaps.detail: No World Language subject family exists in the ten-family model. At most 1.0 credit is substitutable (additional VPAA or a department-approved formal CTE program) and at most a further 0.5 if the personal finance half-credit is directed here. At least 0.5 credit of genuine language study at Novice High proficiency remains uncovered.

Assigned to ma-g9-technology by this contract. Not credit-bearing, so it will not surface in any credit tally. Becomes COVERED when the Technology session delivers an identifiable online learning experience and names where the evidence lives.

The personal finance half-credit displaces 0.5 of mathematics, VPAA, or world language as determined by the board; it is not additive and the 18-credit total is unchanged. Directing it at world language is the only option that reduces a real gap.
No coded MDE standards set could be verified for this family. It must either bind to an official framework or state plainly that it is locally defined and makes no state standards claim.

graduation_completeness.basis: MMC world language is NOT_COVERED with a 0.5 credit irreducible remainder.
graduation_completeness.note: This is a curriculum and coverage design audit against the Michigan Merit Curriculum. It is not a legal opinion and does not decide whether the MMC binds this family. See credit-coverage-map.md.
